thread:
alison: Quick sync: small copy + a11y nit for rollout announcement pill. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/rollout-pill. Need to finalize before code-freeze.
ryan: Keeping the pill as '35%' visually, aria-label should be '35% allocation to Variant C'.
kai: Contrast check: current blue (#6272FF) is 3.1:1 on white at 11px. Increase to 12px or use #3E46D9 for 4.6:1. Also avoid using fill color as sole indicator.
a11y-bot: Auto-scan: #3E46D9 passes AA for normal text. Recommend focus ring 3px and visible outline.
ryan: Rollout announcement: use aria-live='polite' for status region and debounce 1500ms to prevent repeated reads when automation nudges allocation.
alison: Agreed. Action items: kai to post palette, ryan to add aria-snippets to PR, alison to update Figma comment. Target: next minor. :thumbsup:
